cases.description: Rejects canonical workflow name with non-canonical workflow path and blocks caller allowedPaths widening
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (allowed .github/workflows/ci.yml or caller-supplied allowedWorkflowPaths widening)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with NON_CANONICAL_WORKFLOW_PATH; CANONICAL_WORKFLOW_PATHS locked to ['.github/workflows/kh02-ci.yml'])

cases.description: Rejects cross-repo, fork, and pull_request-driven workflow runs
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with FORK_RUN_REJECTED, REPOSITORY_MISMATCH, UNAUTHORIZED_TRIGGER_EVENT)

cases.description: Rejects SHA mismatch, branch mismatch, runId mismatch, and invalid run_attempt
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with HEAD_SHA_MISMATCH, BRANCH_MISMATCH, RUN_ID_MISMATCH, INVALID_RUN_ATTEMPT)

cases.description: Rejects workflow_id mismatch and inactive/disabled workflow state
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with WORKFLOW_ID_MISMATCH and WORKFLOW_NOT_ACTIVE)

cases.description: Rejects a workflow run with only a single dummy/docs-only green job even when caller omits requiredJobs
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (verifyRequiredJobs defaulted requiredJobs to [] when caller omitted it, passing any single green job)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with REQUIRED_JOBS_MISSING; CANONICAL_REQUIRED_JOBS enforced unconditionally)

cases.description: Rejects when any canonical required job is skipped, failed, incomplete, or has a failed step
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (did not enforce all 6 canonical jobs or step-level failure rejection)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with REQUIRED_JOB_NOT_SUCCESS, REQUIRED_JOB_NOT_COMPLETED, REQUIRED_JOB_STEP_FAILED)

cases.description: Rejects duplicate job IDs, job run_attempt conflicts, and incomplete/truncated pagination in fetchGitHubRunJobs
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (accepted truncated job lists when page returned fewer items than total_count)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with DUPLICATE_JOB_ID, JOB_ATTEMPT_MISMATCH, JOBS_COUNT_MISMATCH_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE)

cases.description: Rejects forged HMAC token and verifiedProof without genuine 3-endpoint verification registration
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened with private _resolveCiVerifierSecretInternal)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (getCiVerifierSecret returns key: undefined; unverified attestation rejected with CI_ATTESTATION_NOT_FROM_VERIFIED_GITHUB_API_CALL)

cases.description: Rejects mutation of workflowPath, jobsDigest, or responseDigest after V2 signature minting
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with CI_ATTESTATION_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH)

cases.description: Rejects legacy V1 token (swai_ci_v1_...) for release gate promotion
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with LEGACY_V1_ATTESTATION_REJECTED)

cases.description: Returns CI_NOT_CONFIGURED (never CI_PASS) when GitHub token or HMAC trust anchor is missing
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (classified as CI_NOT_CONFIGURED with ciProviderVerified: false)

cases.description: Rejects HTTP 401/403/404/429/500, redirects, and aborts streaming body before 2 MiB overflow
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (called await res.text() before checking byte length)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (readBoundedResponseBytes aborts stream immediately on >2 MiB or >6 MiB total budget; 429 classified as RATE_LIMITED)

cases.description: Gate E10/E11 validator rejects contradictory status='CI_PASS' with providerVerified=false
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (only checked status !== 'CI_PASS' with ciProviderVerified=true; did not reject status === 'CI_PASS' with providerVerified=false)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (two-way CI_PASS <=> ciProviderVerified && providerVerified invariant enforced)

cases.description: Gate E8/E9 validator rejects missing, invalid, or contradictory JSON
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with ENGINEERING_FAIL)

cases.description: runSingleGate returns ABORTED_FAIL (pass=false) when child times out even if it traps SIGTERM and exits 0
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (close handler checked exitCode === 0 without checking timedOut first)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (if (timedOut) takes unconditional precedence -> ABORTED_FAIL, pass: false)

cases.description: ByteTailRingBuffer enforces 64 KiB cap and sanitizeCiLog redacts secrets while verifying flushed log SHA-256
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened with post-flush disk size + SHA-256 verification)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (verified)

cases.description: checkResourceSafety fails closed when disk/RAM is below threshold or when probe throws
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened with Linux MemAvailable + cgroup v1/v2 support)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (verified)

cases.description: Enforces MAX_CONCURRENT_GATES === 2 and defines all 13 mandatory gates (E1..E13)
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (E12 and E13 were not defined in V19.3.2.8)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (all 13 gates E1..E13 defined with MAX_CONCURRENT_GATES === 2)

cases.description: verifyWorktreeIntegrity fails closed on HEAD SHA or Tree SHA drift
cases.prePatchBehavior: GREEN (retained & hardened)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (rejected with HEAD_MUTATED / TREE_MUTATED)

cases.description: executeRemoteCiProofDiagnostic reports truthful status and all new V19.3.2.9 diagnostic fields when token/runId absent
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (did not expose workflowFileConfigured, remoteRunObserved, remoteRunCompleted, requiredJobsVerified, jobsDigest, errorClassification)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (all V19.3.2.9 diagnostic fields populated truthfully)

cases.description: verifyWorkflowContractV19_3_2_9 validates .github/workflows/kh02-ci.yml and rejects tampered YAML
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (no .github/workflows/kh02-ci.yml or contract validator existed)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (verifies permissions, 40-hex SHA-pinned actions, public guard, no continue-on-error, and all 6 canonical jobs)

cases.description: Only GITHUB_ACTIONS_API source with all 6 canonical required jobs can register a verified CI run
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (_registerVerifiedRemoteCiRun did not enforce all 6 canonical required jobs)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (_registerVerifiedRemoteCiRun throws if any canonical required job is missing)

cases.description: .github/workflows/kh02-ci.yml contains no paid external API triggers or live paid provider flags
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (workflow did not exist)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (verified zero paid API keys or live paid flags in .github/workflows/kh02-ci.yml)

cases.description: Passing extra optional jobs (e.g. lint-docs) cannot mask a missing or failed mandatory canonical job
cases.prePatchBehavior: RED (optional jobs could satisfy caller-specified requiredJobs when canonical jobs were omitted)
cases.postPatchBehavior: GREEN (evaluateReleaseEvidence and validateCiRunBinding reject with CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED / REQUIRED_JOBS_MISSING)
